location_description: Paramus ( pə-RAM-əs) is a borough in Bergen County, New Jersey, United States. A bedroom community of New York City, Paramus is located 15 to 20 miles (24 to 32 km) northwest of Midtown Manhattan and approximately 8 miles (13 km) west of Upper Manhattan. The Wall Street Journal characterized Paramus as "quintessentially suburban".
